implementation: New original Java runtime; not a reconstruction of the excluded reference code or historical binary.
historical_resource_policy: Keep resources/ byte-identical; modify only packaged mcmod.info display metadata and append new recovery-item and compatibility-entity language keys during processResources.
entity_id_evidence: Verified registry ResourceLocation in actual-stage historical Village-Standards-Vale-0.2.0.jar; identity and NBT contract in LEGACY-COMPATIBILITY.json.
dimension_evidence: Recovered mcmod.info specifies five 5x5 wall pictures.

schema.ValeStandardVariant: stone|sand|mist|leaf|cloud; empty string is explicitly unassigned
schema.ValeStandardOrigin: stable UUID for bounded per-origin recovery archival
schema.ValeStandardOwner: UUID of the most recent placing player, informational only
schema.ValeStandardItem: one item with its original metadata and without nested ValeStandardHistory

unknown_data_policy: Retain unknown NBT without guessing its village; migrate only exact valid historical Village integers when current schema markers are absent; otherwise display a visible breakable unassigned panel, preserve history in a recovery item and a first-seen per-origin WorldSavedData archive on break, then permit explicit operator resolution.
archive_growth: One first-seen record per stable original UUID; repeated item/entity cycles do not append or overwrite records.
migration_limit: Synthetic records of the verified historical binary contract pass component/native checks; the actual user world and complete historical mod roster still require first-start/save/restart acceptance.
visual_acceptance: Requires a real Minecraft client check; component and dedicated-server checks alone do not verify rendered appearance.
compatibility_entity_scope: Exact identifier published by authored 0.3.0; registered through a distinct compatibility subclass, with the same rendering and current schema.

legacy_schema.precedence: Current schema/variant/unassigned fields suppress legacy fallback.
legacy_schema.invalid: Missing, wrong-type or out-of-range Village values remain unassigned and retained without coercion or clamping.
